title: NeuroMetBench reproducibility package
description: Post-rejection scientific revision and reproducibility package for NeuroMetBench. Version 2.1.0 reframes the work as a patient-aware evidence-bounding methodology for transcript-derived metabolic representations across cancer proteogenomic contexts, preserves the rejected v2.0.7 state as immutable history, and adds a frozen exploratory cross-cohort attenuation analysis without changing adverse or non-admitted findings. Raw third-party molecular matrices are not redistributed where external source terms govern access. The reusable neurometbench-ref software component remains version 1.0.1.
